==English==
{{was wotd|2010|March|28|2011|March|28|2015|November|6}}

===Etymology===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*ten-}}
From {{uder|en|la|tenāx||holding fast, clinging}}, from {{m|la|teneo|tenēre|to hold}}, {{suffix|en||ious}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/təˈneɪʃəs/|a=RP,GA,CA}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-tenacious.ogg|a=US}}
* {{IPA|en|/təˈnæɪʃəs/|a=AU,NZ}}
** {{audio|en|en-au-tenacious.ogg|a=Queensland}}
* {{rhymes|en|eɪʃəs|s=3}}
* {{hyphenation|en|tena|cious}}

===Adjective===
{{en-adj}}

# [[clinging|Clinging]] to an [[object]] or [[surface]]; [[adhesive]].
# [[unwilling|Unwilling]] to [[yield]] or [[give up]]; [[dogged]].
# [[holding|Holding]] [[together]]; [[cohesive]].
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1873|author=Henry Morton Stanley|title=My Kalulu, Prince, King, and Slave|passage=The quagmiry road, trodden into '''tenacious''' paste by the long file of human beings ahead {{...}}}}
# Having a good [[memory]]; [[retentive]].

====Synonyms====
* {{sense|clinging to an object or surface}} {{l|en|clingsome}}, {{l|en|sticky}}; see also [[Thesaurus:adhesive]]
* {{sense|unwilling to yield or give up}} {{l|en|pigheaded}}, {{l|en|steadfast}}; see also [[Thesaurus:obstinate]]
* {{sense|holding together}} {{l|en|coherent}}; see also [[Thesaurus:cohesive]]
* {{sense|having a good memory}} {{l|en|elephantlike}}, {{l|en|memorious}}; see also [[Thesaurus:memorious]]

====Derived terms====
{{col|en|overtenacious|untenacious
}}

====Related terms====

* {{l|en|tenaciousness}}
* {{l|en|tenacity}}
